markers.label: drawn, not a photo
markers.title: Photo replaced by a drawing
markers.body: The reference’s hero is a photograph of burgers, fries and a can on a wooden table. The rebuild draws them as flat shapes, using SVG art from its own script, tools/gen_images.py. The page’s test stops earlier, at a missing main.landing element, before any screenshot comparison.

markers.label: wrapper redrawn
markers.title: Foil wrapper becomes a flat packet
markers.body: At the top left, the reference has a photographed, crumpled foil wrapper. The rebuild has a red rectangle with a cream border.

markers.label: about 100 px lower
markers.title: Headline and search bar moved down
markers.body: The headline and search bar sit about 100 px lower, and the bar is shorter. The logo is plain text, and all text renders in a generic sans-serif, not Uber Move.

markers.label: white, not green
markers.title: White top bar, narrower banner
markers.body: The reference’s green top bar runs into a full-width banner. The rebuild’s bar is white, its logo is plain text with a green “Eats”, and the banner starts after the side menu. The page’s test stops earlier, at a missing main.feed-page element, before any screenshot comparison.

markers.label: flat banner art
markers.title: Banner art simplified
markers.body: The reference has white 3D shapes and a red % badge. The rebuild has flat white tiles and a pink + badge.

markers.label: smaller logo
markers.title: Dodgers logo redrawn
markers.body: The reference’s large script logo with a baseball becomes a small serif word with an X in a circle above it.

markers.label: drawn food
markers.title: Restaurant photos replaced by drawings
markers.body: Thai Kitchen, Curry Boys DTLA, Eggslut and King Taco show food photographs in the reference and flat drawings in the rebuild. The category icons above them are redrawn too.

markers.label: drawn plates
markers.title: Drawn plates, taller images
markers.body: Each result shows a drawn plate where the reference has a food photograph. The images are 332 px tall, not 232 px, so the second row starts 94 px lower. The page’s test stops earlier, at a missing main.results-page element, before any screenshot comparison.

markers.label: plain buttons
markers.title: Header buttons lose their fill
markers.body: The reference has a black cart button, a grey Log in and a black Sign up. The rebuild has a plain cart icon, plain Log in text and a white, outlined Sign up.

markers.label: drawn dish
markers.title: Dish photo replaced by a drawing
markers.body: The reference shows a photograph of curry on a dark table. The rebuild shows a flat drawing, and so do the menu items below it. The store name and menu sit about 240 px further right. The page’s test stops earlier, at a missing main.store-page element, before any screenshot comparison.

markers.label: no $ sign
markers.title: Prices lose the dollar sign
markers.body: Menu prices read 15.88 in the rebuild and $15.88 in the reference.
